title: Grandma Lan's Sweet Solution
segments: Mrs. Lan stood in her cozy kitchen on a sunny afternoon. Her granddaughter, An, was visiting tomorrow! She wanted to make An’s favorite treat: a sweet and cool lychee jelly dessert. It was the perfect thing for a warm day. She smiled, already imagining An's happy face when she saw it.

Then, she looked for the big pot she needed for the jelly. It was on the lowest shelf in the cupboard. As she bent down to pull out the heavy pot, she felt a sharp pain in her back. "Oh!" she said, stopping immediately. The pot was too heavy to lift.

After that, Mrs. Lan decided to use a smaller, lighter pot. She filled it with water and put it on the stove. She stood there, stirring the sugar and jelly powder. But soon, her back started to hurt again, even more than before. The pain was too strong. She had to stop and sit down.

Because of this, she sat at her kitchen table, feeling sad. She looked at the pot on the stove. The jelly needed to be stirred. Then, she had an idea! She saw the tall stool in the corner of the room. She carefully brought the stool over to the stove and sat down.

Then, sitting comfortably on the stool, Mrs. Lan could finally cook without pain. She smiled as she stirred the sweet liquid. She carefully added the lychees and poured the warm jelly into a glass dish. Finally, she put the dish in the fridge to cool. Her back felt much better.

After that, Mrs. Lan rested while the jelly cooled. Soon, the doorbell rang! Her granddaughter, Mai, ran into the kitchen and gave her a big hug. "Grandma! I'm so happy to see you!" Mai said. Mrs. Lan smiled. "I have a special surprise for you," she said, opening the fridge.
endWrap: Mrs. Lan found a clever way to cook without pain. She and Mai enjoyed the sweet lychee jelly together, happy to be with each other.
